entries.1de4e8c4ca9ee20e: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥171.9 billion (up 65.2% year on year). The company attributes the main factor behind the increase in net income to time lags in Fuel Oil and Basic Chemicals. The earnings of petroleum companies are affected by crude oil prices. Because inventories are valued using the total average method, when crude oil prices rise, relatively low-cost inventories held at the beginning of the period lower cost of sales and improve earnings, whereas when prices fall, the reverse effect worsens earnings. From fiscal 2026, the company states that it will voluntarily apply [[term:ifrs|International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)]].

entries.3bd90ab5edfc036f: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,105.9 billion (down 11.8% year on year), reflecting lower crude oil prices in the Fuel Oil Segment, among other factors. The average price of Dubai crude oil in the period was US$71.8 per barrel, down US$6.7 per barrel from the previous year, and the average dollar-yen rate was ¥150.7 per US dollar, with the yen weaker by ¥1.9 year on year. Revenue from external customers was: Fuel Oil ¥6,793.4 billion (down 11.7%), High-Performance Materials ¥503.2 billion, Basic Chemicals ¥491.4 billion (down 16.3%), Resources ¥203.5 billion (down 23.3%), Electricity and Renewable Energy ¥98.2 billion (down 23.0%) and Other ¥16.3 billion; Fuel Oil accounts for about 84% of consolidated revenue. Within Resources, the oil and natural gas development and geothermal businesses recorded ¥38.8 billion (down 4.0%, due to lower production volumes and lower crude oil prices, among other factors), and the coal and other businesses recorded ¥164.7 billion (down 26.8%, due to price factors associated with the decline in coal market prices, among others). The company endeavors to secure margins by linking petroleum product prices to domestic market prices. Revenue includes gasoline tax and does not include value-added tax or light oil delivery tax. Revenue from sales is recognized at the point in time when products are delivered to customers.
